answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Enthroned freight forwarder certificate with freight agents attestation flips the bet — a certificate agents renew after shipment audits — and the fable lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the inlet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The hollow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
